steps.eval: (()=>{const g=__rhf.game; g.setQuality('high'); g.dpr=1; g.renderer.setPixelRatio(1); g.resize(); g.bears.directorT=9999; g.env.weather.timer=9999; g.hud.firstShown=-1000; __rhf.god(true); const p=g.world.place('landing'); g.player.place(p.x,p.z,p.face); g.player.pitch=0.02; g.env.setTime(10.5); return 'ok'})()

(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const r=g.renderer; const out=[]; const measure=(label,fn)=>{ r.info.autoReset=false; r.info.reset(); fn(); out.push(label+': calls '+r.info.render.calls+' tris '+r.info.render.triangles); r.info.autoReset=true; }; g.updateWorld(0); measure('main only (no shadow update, no probe)',()=>{ const au=r.shadowMap.autoUpdate; r.shadowMap.autoUpdate=false; r.render(g.scene,g.camera); r.shadowMap.autoUpdate=au; }); measure('main + shadows',()=>{ r.shadowMap.needsUpdate=true; r.render(g.scene,g.camera); }); measure('probe face',()=>{ g.water.probe.update(r,g.scene,g.camera.position,1); }); measure('waves',()=>{ g.water.waves.render(r,1); }); measure('lighting band',()=>{ g.lighting.update(g.env.lightDir,1); }); measure('overlay',()=>{ r.render(g.overlay.scene,g.overlay.camera); }); const casters=[]; g.scene.traverse(o=>{ if(o.isMesh&&o.castShadow&&o.visible) casters.push(o.name||o.parent?.name||o.type); }); const cnt={}; for(const c of casters) cnt[c]=(cnt[c]||0)+1; out.push('casters '+casters.length+' '+JSON.stringify(cnt)); return out.join(' | ')})()
